india_trends.title: Urea import prices halve in latest tender, offering relief to subsidy bill
india_trends.summary: The urea import tender by National Fertilizers Ltd (NFL) received landed price (cost-plus-freight) quotes in a range of $444.9-449.3 per tonne, two people aware of the development said. This is less than half the levels seen in an earlier procurement, which had drawn bids of $935–959 per tonne.
